channel.title: Cities & Communities in Anne Arundel County on Anne Arundel Guide
channel.description: Recent content in Cities & Communities in Anne Arundel County on Anne Arundel Guide

item.title: Annapolis
item.description: Annapolis is Maryland's historic capital city, home to the U.S. Naval Academy, the Maryland State House, and one of America's most charming waterfront downtowns.

item.title: Arnold
item.description: Arnold is a charming waterfront community on the Severn River in Anne Arundel County, known for its historic downtown, seafood restaurants, and ferry to Annapolis.

item.title: Crofton
item.description: Crofton is a family-friendly community in central Anne Arundel County with excellent schools, parks, and proximity to Fort Meade and the NSA.

item.title: Crownsville
item.description: Crownsville is a historic community in eastern Anne Arundel County, known for its Chesapeake Bay beaches, maritime history, and waterfront parks.

item.title: Davidsonville
item.description: Davidsonville is a waterfront community on the Patuxent River in southern Anne Arundel County, offering boat ramps, parks, and a relaxed Chesapeake Bay lifestyle.

item.title: Deale
item.description: Deale is a small waterfront community in eastern Anne Arundel County on the Chesapeake Bay, known for its beaches, boat launches, and quiet coastal living.

item.title: Fort Meade
item.description: Fort Meade is a U.S. Army installation in Anne Arundel County, home to the NSA and CIA, and a major employer for military and federal workers.

item.title: Gambrills
item.description: Gambrills is a suburban community in southern Anne Arundel County with a mix of residential areas, shopping centers, and proximity to historic London Town.

item.title: Glen Burnie
item.description: Glen Burnie is the largest community in Anne Arundel County, offering diverse neighborhoods, shopping centers, restaurants, and easy access to Baltimore.

item.title: Millersville
item.description: Millersville is a suburban community in western Anne Arundel County near Fort Meade, known for its family-friendly neighborhoods and proximity to federal employment.

item.title: Odenton
item.description: Odenton is a growing community in western Anne Arundel County near Fort Meade, with a new downtown development, parks, and excellent schools.

item.title: Parole
item.description: Parole is a small rural community in western Anne Arundel County, known for its countryside setting, horse farms, and quiet country living.

item.title: Pasadena
item.description: Pasadena is a small residential community in central Anne Arundel County near the Patuxent Research Refuge, offering a quiet suburban lifestyle.

item.title: Severn
item.description: Severn is a suburban community in central Anne Arundel County along the Severn River, offering residential neighborhoods, parks, and proximity to Annapolis.

item.title: Severna Park
item.description: Severna Park is one of Anne Arundel County's most desirable communities, known for its excellent schools, walkable downtown, and family-friendly atmosphere.

item.title: Sunnydale
item.description: Sunnydale is a small residential community in eastern Anne Arundel County, known for its quiet suburban feel and proximity to Chesapeake Bay beaches.
